about.title: About me
about.p1: I’m a systems engineer working in software development, with experience across frontend, backend, and cloud technologies. My work includes employee self-service software, where interfaces and services support specific tasks such as downloading payroll documents, requesting leave, and managing internal information.
about.p2: My main tools include TypeScript, Vue.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, alongside AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. I work directly with businesses and teams on focused projects, from a single internal tool to a platform that needs its backend, data, and deployment set up properly.

services.title: What I can build for you
services.intro: I take on development projects with a clear scope and work with you directly, from the first conversation to the deployment. These are the services I offer.

webapps.title: Business web applications
webapps.text: Build or extend internal tools, dashboards, and self-service applications for specific business workflows, using Vue.js, TypeScript, and a Node.js backend.

backend.title: Backend services & integrations
backend.text: Develop APIs and backend features, connect application components, and work with PostgreSQL to support the data behind business processes.
